items.text:
The man deserved the 500k.
He literally spent *ALL* those months inside of a red circle for it...
Hats off to him.

Crazy that jimmy was doing multiple challenges at once. The chocolate factory, the no eating challenge, and this one. And maybe others we don’t even know about. The dedication and hard work this guy puts into his videos

The dedication, the determination, the discipline this man has is unmatched. I could feel him almost stepping out, but thinking about his family made him stronger and gave him the drive he needed to persevere. Well done
Rip Oliver tree 17:00
"Make sure you trade your life for something worthy" , what a quote man. Respect for dads around the world for fighting every day for their family.
This is incredible. The fact that he's doing this for his family just makes it even more special.
Bro lost 22 pounds, won 500k for his family and withstood chandlers chaos, this guy is a legend

in my opinion this is the best video you have ever done. he could have spent 100 days worth of working at any other job in the world and wouldn't ever get paid that much. You have given him a life with his children and his wife. God bless you Jimmy.
It's unbeleivable the sacrifice he's making for his family. Someone get this man a medal.
Huge props to whoever set up the last scene with the smoke and all the people, it's chaotically extremely beautiful
Good for jimmy for allowing him to see his family on Father’s Day that was a great touch that a lot of people may have overlooked
Your efforts are paying off in incredible ways. The inspiration you provide is unmistakable. Keep raising the bar!
I'm so glad he made it. He deserves it for all he went through
The fact that the house stayed supported by the stairs and the garden the whole time is actually insane
This man is willing to do anything to make his family happy. The dads out there are underrated.
Surviving 100 days inside a circle for $500,000 is the ultimate mental test! The fact that people actually pull this off blows my mind. Legend! ⭕⏳💰

May , June , July , August 🥶🥴

That's crazy insane I'm glad he won that $500K
This man's love and dedication tor his family is unreal

is it just me or did this guy handle this almost perfectly? he did super well. he deserves the win more that most on this channel. 

"make sure youre trading your life for things that are worth it"
J'aime tellement tout ce que vous faites. Je rêve d'avoir ça en Afrique plus précisément au Togo. Je vous aime.

" I rather die than give up"
This man is the definition of determination. 
He deserved that money
That was insane jimmy!! CRAZY surprise at the end 🎉
Mad respect to him for sticking it through and remembering the end goal and how much he wanted to make his family happy. He killed that challenge 🙌🏽.
This video is still one of our favorites.  Shawn seems like such a cool guy.  Hope he and his family are well
“I think I’d rather die than give up” the words of a father who wants only the best for his family and won’t stop till he gets it. Respect
